result.text: `; } /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */ /* Ventas e ingresos */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */ const SALES_RANGES = [ { id: "year", label: "Este año" }, { id: "quarter", label: "Este trimestre" }, { id: "month", label: "Este mes" }, { id: "campaign", label: "Últimos 12 meses" }, { id: "all", label: "Todo lo registrado" }, { id: "custom", label: "Elegir fechas" }, ]; /** El periodo que se está mirando: fechas desde/hasta y su nombre. */ function salesWindow() { return windowFor(ui.sales); } /** Lo mismo, para cualquier pantalla que elija un periodo. */ function windowFor(state) { const now = new Date(); const y = now.getFullYear(); const two = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0"); const today = todayISO(); const monthFrom = `${y}-${two(now.getMonth() + 1)}-01`; const quarterFrom = `${y}-${two(Math.floor(now.getMonth() / 3) * 3 + 1)}-01`; const yearAgo = `${y - 1}-${two(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${two(now.getDate())}`; const range = state.range; if (range === "month") return { id: range, from: monthFrom, to: today, label: "Este mes" }; if (range === "quarter") return { id: range, from: quarterFrom, to: today, label: "Este trimestre" }; if (range === "campaign") return { id: range, from: yearAgo, to: today, label: "Últimos 12 meses" }; if (range === "all") return { id: range, from: "", to: "", label: "Todo lo registrado" }; if (range === "custom") { const from = state.from || ""; const to = state.to || ""; const label = from && to ? `Del ${fmtDate(from)} al ${fmtDate(to)}` : from ? `Desde el ${fmtDate(from)}` : to ? `Hasta el ${fmtDate(to)}` : "Elige las fechas"; return { id: range, from, to, label }; } return { id: "year", from: `${y}-01-01`, to: today, label: "Este año" }; }
